experiment: P3h MLCNN-latent plus shared-physics P1n prefilter sufficiency
research_question: Do already-computed MLCNN classification embeddings add enough information beyond probabilities and raw physics to predict P1n decision changes at <=30 percent UNet coverage?
gate_and_selection: identical to P3g; balanced leaf7 HGB and >=0.98 changed recall with every cell >=0.90
stop_rule: If latent-feature sufficiency fails, do not train a deeper probability gate on the same teacher; the next architecture must jointly learn/distill a new shared representation on fresh identities.
